studentExemption.applyUrlNotes: Online council tax account (sign in/register) is the web route. Alternatives listed on the council page: PDF form https://durham.gov.uk/media/2747/Student-and-student-nurse-council-tax-discount-form/pdf/CouncilTaxStudentEnquiryForm.pdf, or email/phone via https://durham.gov.uk/article/3590/Contact-Council-Tax (counciltax@durham.gov.uk, 03000 26 4000). Only one application needed per household. No dedicated standalone online student-exemption form was found.
studentExemption.quote: You are only exempt from paying Council Tax if all the people living in a property are full-time students ... If there is one person who is not a student, you will only a receive a 25% discount. ... If there are two people who are not students, you will not receive a discount at all.

councilTax.secondarySource: https://housecheckup.co.uk/council-tax/durham (cites MHCLG 'Council Tax levels set by local authorities in England 2026 to 2027', Table 9)
councilTax.notes: Claimed figures are real but are the MHCLG area-AVERAGE Band D (£2,622.15) INCLUDING average parish precepts, with other bands derived by statutory ratios (6/9, 7/9, 8/9). councildata.co.uk itself was not found. They are NOT what a Durham City student house would be billed. Council's own bands page (no year label on page; inferred 2026/27 because the council's 'Last year's council tax' page covers 2025/26 with unparished Band D £2,436.06) gives base totals excl. parish: A £1,666.64, B £1,944.42, C £2,222.19, D £2,499.97 (County Council £2,071.11 + Police £300.74 + Fire £128.12 at Band D). City of Durham parish (incl. Charter Trustees) row: A £1,712.18, B £1,997.55, C £2,282.91, D £2,568.28. Unparished former City of Durham area: A £1,668.44, D £2,502.67. Belmont D £2,539.80; Framwellgate Moor D £2,545.36. Recommend using City of Durham row for central Durham student houses. Irrelevant to all-student houses (exempt, £0).

According to our data, you'll pay a median annual price of £53 for your tenants contents insurance if you rent a bungalow, £54 if you live in a flat and £61 if you rent a house.
averages.notes: £53 is GoCompare's median for renters of BUNGALOWS only; a rented house is £61. Data period reported as 1 Sep 2025 - 28 Feb 2026. GoCompare pages blocked direct fetch (bot interstitial), quote obtained via search-result extract. Search extract also reports GoCompare student-living-away-from-home median of £69/yr (£84 paying monthly) on https://www.gocompare.com/home-insurance/student-insurance/ - not directly confirmed.

insurers.name: Howden (formerly Endsleigh) - Student Contents Insurance via studentGuard
insurers.notes: Loads. 'Howden are delighted to introduce student contents insurance via studentGuard.' Covers students 'living in a student house or halls without cover'; includes £5,000 tenant's liability. Endsleigh's student page (https://www.endsleigh.co.uk/endsleigh-students/) says 'We've moved!' - 'our student offering has now become fully Howden branded.' So Endsleigh no longer sells student contents under its own brand.
